projects.name: ImpactGlobe
projects.description: Offline-first incident reporting app with local AI inference.
projects.problem: Communities need a reliable way to report incidents (accidents, hazards, garbage) even without internet access, and sensitive photos shouldn't be sent to cloud servers.
projects.motivation: Provide a privacy-first, offline-capable solution for community incident reporting.
built_features: Local AI inference using MobileNetV3 to classify incidents.
Heuristic regression for real-time CO2 emissions tracking.
Flutter + Firebase Firestore backend with real-time sync.
projects.ai_components: On-device inference using MobileNetV3 CNN (Transfer Learning).
projects.key_decision: Choosing on-device inference (MobileNetV3) over a cloud API to eliminate latency, work offline, and keep sensitive incident photos off external servers.

projects.name: TransitOps
projects.problem: Managing hardware tracking, HR, and financial analytics for fleets requires a unified, real-time command center.
built_features: Real-time trip lifecycle planning and fuel intelligence with anomaly detection.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with gated write operations and audit logging.
projects.key_decision: Building a fully synchronized, real-time interface across multiple modules required careful state management and real-time database architecture to prevent redundant fetches.

projects.name: CrowdPulse
projects.problem: Proactively identifying crowd anomalies requires high-accuracy tracking and low latency.
built_features: Real-time object detection and density mapping pipelines using YOLOv8.
Flask web dashboard featuring passkey authentication and interactive hotspot zones.
projects.ai_components: YOLOv8 tracking algorithms deployed on Hugging Face Spaces using PyTorch and CUDA 12.1.
projects.key_decision: Optimized YOLOv8 algorithms and moved AI inference to an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA 12.1) to achieve real-time processing speeds without sacrificing precision.

projects.name: AyurWell
projects.problem: Generating highly personalized Ayurvedic diet plans safely based on user surveys.
built_features: Scoring algorithm mapping user survey inputs to Ayurvedic Dosha profiles.
Dynamic generation of personalized, season-aware dietary plans.
Fluid dashboard using Recharts to visualize wellness progress.
projects.ai_components: Integrated LLMs with strict prompt chaining and validation layers.
projects.key_decision: Implemented a strict prompt chaining pipeline with validation layers to ensure the AI generated safe health advice.

projects.name: ChessAnalyzer
projects.problem: Running a heavy C++ chess engine in JS without freezing the UI.
built_features: Play-vs-Stockfish with adjustable strength and multi-engine support.
Move classification, multi-PV engine lines, and game summaries.
Zero backend dependency.
projects.key_decision: Compiled Stockfish to WebAssembly (WASM) and ran it inside Web Workers, communicating via message passing to prevent UI freezing.

projects.name: HeritageGuide
projects.problem: Providing fast, multimodal routing and accurate site discovery for heritage sites.
built_features: Dynamic map integration using Leaflet and OpenStreetMap.
Full-stack Django architecture handling secure slot booking, authentication, and routing.
Firebase-backed real-time data flow for peak hour updates.
projects.key_decision: Integrated with OpenRouteService APIs and cached frequent routes in Redis to minimize API costs and latency.

projects.name: EduCycle
projects.problem: Students need a secure, fast, offline-capable peer-to-peer marketplace.
built_features: Integrated Stripe for secure, verified student-to-student transactions.
PWA architecture enabling students to browse and message offline.
Redis caching to serve the marketplace feed in under 100ms.
projects.key_decision: Decoupled the chat microservice using WebSockets while Django handled heavy DB relations.

projects.name: WatchParty
projects.problem: Relaying video through a central server is expensive and slow for small watch parties.
built_features: Custom WebRTC signaling server using Socket.IO.
Robust timestamp synchronization algorithms.
Zero-install architecture focusing on pure client-side P2P media flow.
projects.key_decision: Forced a pure P2P mesh network for smaller rooms instead of relaying video, using a signaling server purely to orchestrate connections.

projects.name: Nexus Financial
projects.problem: Ensuring transaction atomicity and security during concurrent ATM operations.
built_features: Double-entry ledger system to guarantee atomic, ACID-compliant transactions.
Strict security measures using JDBC prepared statements.
Comprehensive dual-table audit trail.
projects.key_decision: Heavily utilized MySQL row-level locking (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) to prevent race conditions.
